headings.heading: train
headings.summary: Dialogues where users inquire about train schedules, book train tickets, and confirm journey details.

decisions.reason: Accurately represents the destination station of the journey.
Accurately represents the scheduled arrival time.
Valid attribute representing the day of the week the train departs.
Accurately represents the origin station.
Accurately captures the train's departure time.
Too general and captures irrelevant entities like the town information center itself.
It captures the number of people traveling, so 'number of passengers' is a more standard term.
The value is almost always 'station', making it a static policy rather than a user preference.
A more standard and descriptive name for a reservation identifier.
'Total fare' is the conventional term for the price of train tickets.
Clearly identifies the specific train.
Accurately represents the duration of the journey.

new_attributes.name: ticket class
new_attributes.description: The class of the ticket, such as first class or standard.
new_attributes.label: ticket class
new_attributes.reason: Users frequently have preferences for seating classes on trains.

new_attributes.name: ticket type
new_attributes.description: Indicates whether the ticket is for a single or a return journey.
new_attributes.label: ticket type
new_attributes.reason: Booking systems typically need to know if a trip is one-way or round-trip.

new_attributes.name: departure date
new_attributes.description: The specific calendar date when the outbound train departs.
new_attributes.label: departure date
new_attributes.reason: Essential for booking a ticket on a specific day of the year.

new_attributes.name: return date
new_attributes.description: The specific calendar date for the return journey.
new_attributes.label: return date
new_attributes.reason: Necessary when booking a return train ticket.

new_attributes.name: return time
new_attributes.description: The requested departure or arrival time for the return journey.
new_attributes.label: return time
new_attributes.reason: Users often specify what time they want to travel back.

headings.heading: hotel
headings.summary: Conversations centered on searching for and reserving hotel or guesthouse accommodations based on user preferences.

decisions.reason: The extracted values are specific names of hotels or bed and breakfasts, duplicating the hotel name attribute.
Accurately captures the physical address of the accommodation.
The extracted values like 'room' or 'city' do not represent amenities, making this noise.
Removing 'generic' makes it a cleaner, standard attribute name.
Correctly captures the name of the establishment being booked.
'Area' is more specific than 'location' to describe parts of a town like 'north' or 'centre'.
Accurately captures the duration of the stay.
This represents the system's count of search results, not a user constraint or property.
'Number of guests' is the industry standard term for occupancy.
Correctly identifies the contact number for the accommodation.
Accurately captures the postal code.
'Price range' is a much better and standard name than 'price adjective'.
More descriptive standard name for the confirmation ID.
This attribute belongs under the restaurant heading, not hotel.
Values are specific names of accommodations, which should just be part of the hotel name attribute.
Valid attribute representing the star rating of the accommodation.
The values represent days of the week, so 'start day' is more accurate than 'start date'.

new_attributes.name: internet available
new_attributes.description: Whether the accommodation provides free internet or wifi.
new_attributes.label: internet available
new_attributes.reason: A very common amenity users filter for when choosing accommodations.

new_attributes.name: parking available
new_attributes.description: Whether the accommodation provides parking facilities.
new_attributes.label: parking available
new_attributes.reason: Crucial requirement for guests traveling by car.

new_attributes.name: room type
new_attributes.description: The kind of room requested, such as a single, double, or family room.
new_attributes.label: room type
new_attributes.reason: Users typically specify the exact type of bed setup or room size they need.

new_attributes.name: pet friendly
new_attributes.description: Whether the accommodation allows guests to bring pets.
new_attributes.label: pet friendly

headings.heading: restaurant
headings.summary: Dialogues focused on finding dining options and making table reservations at restaurants matching specific criteria.

decisions.reason: Accurately represents the part of the city the user wants to eat in.
'Reservation day' is clearer in the context of booking a table.
'Cuisine' is the standard term for food type when discussing restaurants.
Represents the system's count of search results rather than a meaningful user parameter.
'Party size' is the standard restaurant industry term for the number of diners.
Duplicates the restaurant postcode attribute.
Describes the same concept (price range) as the other price range attribute; they should be unified.
Renaming to the standard 'price range' concept to act as the primary attribute for budget.
A more standard and descriptive name.
Values are confusingly mixed with search counts, and 15-minute table holds aren't standard reservation durations.
Correctly represents the physical street address.
Accurately represents the establishment's name.
Correctly represents the contact number.
Valid attribute for identifying the postal code of the establishment.
Duplicates the reservation reference number attribute.
Simplifying the name makes it cleaner and more standard.
Captures generic terms like 'restaurant' or 'hotel' which do not act as useful search constraints.
The values actually describe general areas (like 'city center') rather than specific addresses, making it a duplicate of area.

new_attributes.name: dietary restrictions
new_attributes.description: Specific food requirements such as vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free.
new_attributes.label: dietary restrictions
new_attributes.reason: A very common constraint users have when selecting where to eat.

new_attributes.name: outdoor seating
new_attributes.description: Whether the restaurant offers patio or outdoor seating.
new_attributes.label: outdoor seating
new_attributes.reason: Often requested by diners depending on weather preferences.

new_attributes.name: atmosphere
new_attributes.description: The general vibe of the restaurant, such as romantic, casual, or kid-friendly.
new_attributes.label: atmosphere
new_attributes.reason: Users often look for specific environments for dates or business meals.
